title: In the brand we trust? The moderating role of journalistic values and news topics in the relation between news source and trust in news
descriptions: Data collected in the context of a paper examining the relation between news source and trust, while considering the moderating role of journalistic values and type of issue the news deals with (politicized/ not politicized). We conducted a survey experiment in the Netherlands and Sweden.
